_doc: Composition gates a sub-tile may name with spec "benched_by" (tools/ref_tile/README.md, 'Behavioural bench at submit'). The loop reads THIS file from main (the daemon tree), never from the job's branch, and appends each gate's benches to the job as <gate>_<name>; they run in the job's own source snapshot, so the composition is built from the sub-tile's RTL at its source commit. Every gate needs >= 1 behavioural expect=pass bench and >= 1 expect=fail mutant.

s81hc_ng64.what: S81 HC slab composition, NG64, hierarchical (root tile + column chains): bit-exact against the DPI golden; mutant 1 (no write-back) must fail

benches.name: exact
benches.cmd: export PATH=/home/ubuntu/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin:$PATH; python3 tools/s81_suhc/hc_gate.py prep --cases /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/s81-suhc/su_cases_v2_ildr.pkl --out {RUN}/bench/cg_ng64 --ng 64 && python3 tools/s81_suhc/hc_gate.py run --out {RUN}/bench/cg_ng64 --ng 64 --hier 2

benches.name: mutant
benches.cmd: export PATH=/home/ubuntu/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin:$PATH; python3 tools/s81_suhc/hc_gate.py prep --cases /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/s81-suhc/su_cases_v2_ildr.pkl --out {RUN}/bench/cg_ng64m1 --ng 64 && python3 tools/s81_suhc/hc_gate.py run --out {RUN}/bench/cg_ng64m1 --ng 64 --hier 2 --mut 1

quant_wide_wq3.what: HBM quant_wide cluster composition, record-overlap variant (WQ=3, OVERLAP=1, DEC3; ot_hgi_quant_wide_ov with its rq/wq/dec3 children): the eight production DS-shape records, all 3,328 output words bit-exact against the released golden; the wide lane-to-sector mutant (WMUT=1) must mismatch in simulation. Exactness only: the cycle count is read from the same log against the immutable price 168 and is not judged here

benches.name: exact
benches.cmd: export PATH=/home/ubuntu/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin:$PATH; V=/srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/hgi-tput-1010/vec/qdqvec; [ "$(cd $V && find . -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" = af24e0e245041455d83de87ded84c0495b6a7990d802634f35ad6bc7643dfd8c ] || { echo QW_GATE_VECTORS_BAD; exit 97; }; WQ=3 OVERLAP=1 QDQ_DEFS=+define+OT_QW_DEC3 bash tools/hgi_unit_tput/run_qdq_wide.sh $V {RUN}/bench/cg_qw3 && cat {RUN}/bench/cg_qw3/m0.log && [ "$(cat {RUN}/bench/cg_qw3/m0.rc)" = 0 ]
